		Dataset Description
	

The PAI-Bench is a benchmark to measure the progress of world models quantitatively.
The predict task contains a list of 1044 samples of text prompts, conditioning images, and qa pairs, covering Physical AI target domains including autonomous vehicle (AV) driving, robotics, industry (smart space), physics, human, and common sense.
